title: I Am the True Vine, Disciples' Relation to Each Other and the World

questions.question: "I am the true vine, and my Father is the..."?
questions.explanation: John 15:1 (ESV): "I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinedresser."

questions.question: What does the Father do to every branch in Jesus that does not bear fruit?
questions.explanation: John 15:2 (ESV): "Every branch in me that does not bear fruit he takes away..."

questions.question: What does the Father do to every branch that does bear fruit?
options: he prunes it, that it may bear more fruit
questions.correctAnswer: he prunes it, that it may bear more fruit
questions.explanation: John 15:2 (ESV): "...and every branch that does bear fruit he prunes, that it may bear more fruit."

questions.question: Jesus tells the disciples they are already clean because of what?
options: "because of the word that I have spoken to you."
questions.correctAnswer: "because of the word that I have spoken to you."
questions.explanation: John 15:3 (ESV): "Already you are clean because of the word that I have spoken to you."

questions.question: "I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can..."?
questions.explanation: John 15:5 (ESV): "I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing."

questions.question: What happens to a person who does not abide in Jesus?
options: he is thrown away like a branch and withers; and the branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned
questions.correctAnswer: he is thrown away like a branch and withers; and the branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned
questions.explanation: John 15:6 (ESV): "If anyone does not abide in me he is thrown away like a branch and withers; and the branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned."

questions.question: "By this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit and so prove to be my..."?
questions.explanation: John 15:8 (ESV): "By this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit and so prove to be my disciples."

questions.question: Jesus said He told them these things "that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be..."?
questions.explanation: John 15:11 (ESV): "These things I have spoken to you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be full."

questions.question: "Greater love has no one than this..."?
options: "that someone lay down his life for his friends."
"that someone gives all he has to the poor."
"that someone prays entirely for his enemies."
questions.correctAnswer: "that someone lay down his life for his friends."
questions.explanation: John 15:13 (ESV): "Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends."

questions.question: Jesus says He no longer calls them servants, because a servant does not know what his master is doing. What does He call them instead?
questions.explanation: John 15:15 (ESV): "No longer do I call you servants, for the servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all that I have heard from my Father I have made known to you."

questions.question: "You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and..."?
options: "...bear fruit and that your fruit should abide"
questions.correctAnswer: "...bear fruit and that your fruit should abide"
questions.explanation: John 15:16 (ESV): "You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit and that your fruit should abide..."

questions.question: If the world hates the disciples, what should they keep in mind?
options: "know that it has hated me before it hated you."
"know that it is blinded entirely by Satan."
"know that you are sinners completely too."
"know that justice will come securely completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "know that it has hated me before it hated you."
questions.explanation: John 15:18 (ESV): "If the world hates you, know that it has hated me before it hated you."

questions.question: Why does the world hate the disciples?
options: Because they are not of the world, but Jesus chose them out of the world
Because they speak the truth entirely boldly
Because they overthrow safely leaders completely
questions.correctAnswer: Because they are not of the world, but Jesus chose them out of the world
questions.explanation: John 15:19 (ESV): "If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you."

questions.question: Jesus said if He had not come and spoken to them, and if He had not done works that no one else did among them, they would not have been guilty of sin. But now what do they have?
options: "they have no excuse for their sin."
"they have a chance for a sacrifice entirely."
"they have a heavy burden securely completely."
"they have entirely grace tightly covering completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "they have no excuse for their sin."
questions.explanation: John 15:22 (ESV): "If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have been guilty of sin, but now they have no excuse for their sin."

questions.question: Who will bear witness about Jesus when He comes from the Father?
options: The Helper, the Spirit of truth
questions.correctAnswer: The Helper, the Spirit of truth
questions.explanation: John 15:26 (ESV): "But when the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will bear witness about me."

key_verse_text: "I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing."
